finding: Host-side driver dereferences sandbox-controlled symlinks when copying ledgers and dissent envelopes out of the sandbox; a planted link exfiltrates any operator-readable host file into persisted eval artefacts.
reasoning_trace: Traced sandbox-writable .eval/ (info/exclude only, :476) to host-side cp/wc/sed at :713,:715,:769,:773,:774,:777; container runs as host uid on a bind mount (:686) so link targets resolve on the host; verified cp 9.1 dereferences a symlink source operand.
critique: The sandbox is UNTRUSTED per the harness's own trust model (sandbox-mount.sh:97-99, DEC-0413) but its filesystem metadata is trusted.
remediation: Refuse symlinks and non-regular files before every host-side read of a sandbox path; copy with cp -P after the check; add a bats case planting a symlink that expects infrastructure_error.

code_snippet: PROJECT_ROOT="$ws" bash "$ubs" --opt-out "eval sandbox: br not on PATH"
finding: init_sandbox_beads executes the sandbox's .claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh on the host, outside the container, whenever br is absent; :386 has the same shape for the prompt tree's tools/gen-checksums.sh.
reasoning_trace: pipeline-run.sh:489 calls init_sandbox_beads on the host before any container starts; the script path is under $ws/.claude, copied from --source-tree (:131); header :97-99 states no harness script may source .claude/ code; pipeline-run.bats:248-259 scans source lines only.
critique: Defeats the container, two-mount rule, read-only root and env allowlist for a PR-controlled script.
remediation: Write the opt-out marker from the library; always use the inline hashing path for the sandbox manifest; extend the trust-boundary test to exec of $ws/.claude or $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE paths.

finding: git ls-files reads the index, so a tracked .claude/ fence file deleted from the working tree is still counted and the count mismatch the previous find-based check detected is suppressed.
reasoning_trace: Diff base→head replaces find -type f with git ls-files; the find fallback at :196 runs only when the tracked count is 0; confirms review Changes Required #5 and the review dissent's BLOCKING finding.
critique: Preflight runs before every skill and is the strict-mode exit-1 gate (:204-214).
remediation: Count only tracked paths that exist in the working tree, or subtract git ls-files --deleted; add a deleted-file unit case.

finding: On a submodule mount every absent manifest path exists under .loa/ by construction, so the Missing branch is unreachable: a deleted fence link is informational not-mounted and the exit code stays 0.
reasoning_trace: submodule_mount set from -d .loa/.claude (:64); base reported Missing + exit 1; no hash comparison of .loa/<path>; no deleted-link bats case; raised by both dissents (review advisory, audit DISS-C-001).
critique: Together with SEC-003 both downstream integrity checks pass after a fence is deleted.
remediation: Use the mount's link inventory to distinguish never-linked from removed; treat a path as Missing when its parent dir is linked; compare .loa/<path> hash in the not-mounted branch; add the deleted-link case.

finding: Sandbox-written cost-ledger rows are summed without a sign or type clamp; a negative row makes SPENT_MICRO negative, inflates the watchdog budget and defeats the per-run cap. Same in ablation-row.sh:242,312 and spend.sh:129.
reasoning_trace: Followed ledger_micro into SPENT_MICRO (:854), budget (:719) and the cap check (:864); the ledger lives in agent-writable sandbox/.eval/.
critique: The thing being metered controls part of the meter.
remediation: select numeric and >= 0 per row; clamp to [0, cap]; same in spend.sh and ablation-row.sh.

finding: Container for an autonomous bypass-permissions agent lacks --cap-drop=ALL and --security-opt=no-new-privileges; Debian slim ships setuid su/mount/passwd/chsh etc.; egress unrestricted.
reasoning_trace: Read the docker argv assembly :685-696 and the resource-flag test :632-657; checked the setuid set of a Debian base.
critique: Read-only root and non-root uid limit but do not remove local escalation surface.
remediation: Add --cap-drop=ALL --security-opt=no-new-privileges:true; consider an egress-restricted network; assert in the bats resource-flags case.

finding: Operator Codex auth.json is copied under <run>/meta/home, mounted rw into the agent's container, and survives a SIGKILLed driver inside a results tree that batch tooling archives.
reasoning_trace: make_home :563-573; cleanup only in finish/on_exit (:348,:356); header :104-106 acknowledges SIGKILL leaves records behind.
critique: A run tree is not a credential store; the agent under test receives a long-lived operator OAuth token.
remediation: Place the per-run HOME outside the run tree (mktemp -d) or mount the codex files read-only from a dedicated 0700 dir; sweep stale homes; use a scoped eval credential.

finding: Transcripts and stderr are persisted raw with no redaction of SECRET_KEYS values the driver knows; the only guard (pipeline-run.bats:726) is a bare negated grep inside a for loop that cannot fail.
reasoning_trace: Agent env carries AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK; any env dump lands in events-<label>.jsonl which ablation-row.sh and batch artefacts keep; bash exempts ! from errexit (review #4).
critique: The advertised guarantee 'no secret in any capture or log' is neither enforced nor tested.
remediation: Post-phase scan of events/stderr for every set secret value → redact or infrastructure_error; make the bats assertions failing with run ! grep.

finding: integrity_clean never enforces the driver-recorded manifest_sha256; tamper-then-regenerate passes, and the walk iterates manifest entries only so injected .claude/ files are invisible.
reasoning_trace: Read rule_integrity_clean :234-268; msha fetched but only compared for decoration; confirms review Observation §1.
critique: The one driver-owned anchor is ignored.
remediation: FAIL on filesha != msha; FAIL on unlisted regular files under sandbox/.claude/.

finding: The new integrity-manifest gate is red on this PR: ten manifest-covered files change and no .claude/checksums.json is regenerated; the paths: filter also omits .claude/skills, protocols, rules, loa and the manifest itself.
reasoning_trace: gen-checksums.sh:143-168 exits 1 on absent/drifted manifest; head.diff carries no checksums.json; review observed DRIFT 10 paths.
critique: An integrity gate that cannot pass is bypassed in practice.
remediation: Run tools/gen-checksums.sh and commit the manifest; extend the paths filter.

finding: ignore-scripts is set where the agent never reads it (exec shim allowlist drops the env; :77 writes /root/.npmrc while the process runs as host uid with HOME=/home/evaluser), so npm lifecycle scripts of anything the agent installs run.
reasoning_trace: Cross-checked PASS_KEYS/envkv at pipeline-run.sh:631,661-670 and make_home :563-573.
remediation: Add NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS to the pass-through keys or write ignore-scripts=true into $HOME_DIR/.npmrc in make_home.

finding: The checksums.json symlink target is unconstrained; git runs in whatever tree the link names and honours that repo's config (fsmonitor/hooksPath).
remediation: Require MANIFEST_TREE to be PROJECT_ROOT or PROJECT_ROOT/.loa; pass -c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null.
